_comment: Daemon config for the Codex leg of the coordination e2e. `codexOverrides` is on because a bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is not enough for Codex — it prefers a signed-in account and refuses an uncatalogued model — so Medulla's `-c` provider block and derived model catalog are what get the mock answering. `baseUrl` keeps the /v1 suffix: Codex appends only /responses. The top-level [router] is the same endpoint by another route: the capability probe spawns with the daemon's router rather than with a preset (src/sdk/src/daemon/task_loop/probe.rs), and harness.sh exports the matching MEDULLA_CODEX_* knobs into the daemon environment so that probe gets the overrides too. The port placeholder is substituted by write_harness_config.
